verdict.rationale: uv provides multiple concrete pinning mechanisms: `uv.lock` records exact resolved versions and is respected across environments, `uv python pin` pins the Python version to `.python-version`, `uv add pkg==x` and `uvx pkg@version` pin exact package/tool versions, and tool upgrades explicitly respect version constraints while `--upgrade-package` preserves the rest of the lockfile. This is well documented across docs and CLI examples with community confirmation that uv 'just works' for reproducible environments. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that lockfile pins are perfectly respected across all edge cases (e.g. pre-release version handling was called 'unusual' by a user), so a fully clean confirmation is absent.
